findings.summary: glog-config.cmake and glog-config-version.cmake not generated or installed
findings.evidence: CMake generates glog-config.cmake via configure_package_config_file (line 992-995) and glog-config-version.cmake via write_basic_package_version_file (line 997-999), then installs both (line 1040-1043) to lib/cmake/glog/. These are the entry-point files any downstream cmake find_package(glog CONFIG) call requires before it can locate glog-targets.cmake. Bazel cmake_config_bundle (elements/glog/BUILD.bazel) contains only glog-targets.cmake; neither config file is generated by any write_file, genrule, or configure_file equivalent. Without them an installed glog package is unusable by cmake consumers.

findings.summary: C++14 minimum language standard not enforced on glog or its consumers
findings.evidence: CMake line 409 sets target_compile_features(glog PUBLIC cxx_std_14), propagating the C++14 requirement to every consumer. Bazel elements/glog/BUILD.bazel copts for glog and glog_internal contain only visibility and config-select flags; no -std=c++14, no features=["cxx14"] or equivalent. A consumer building with a C++11 default toolchain will silently get compilation errors or undefined behaviour because the standard requirement is absent.

findings.summary: Windows/Cygwin platform handling completely absent from Bazel BUILD
findings.evidence: CMake adds src/windows/port.cc (lines 381-387), GLOG_USE_WINDOWS_PORT private define (lines 418-421), NOMINMAX and WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN private defines (lines 424-429), public GLOG_NO_ABBREVIATED_SEVERITIES define (lines 471-473), and src/windows/ include directories for glog and glog_internal (lines 484-492) when targeting WIN32 or Cygwin. The Bazel glog and glog_internal targets carry no select() for Windows and omit windows/port.cc from srcs entirely. A Windows Bazel build would silently produce an unusable library missing the port layer.

findings.summary: glog-modules.cmake hardcodes the converter's temporary build path
findings.evidence: CMake computes glog_REL_CMake_DATADIR as a path relative to the install prefix at lines 1007-1013, then substitutes it into glog-modules.cmake.in at line 1018 so cmake consumers can find FindUnwind.cmake. Bazel write_file gen_glog_modules_cmake (elements/glog/BUILD.bazel) instead emits the literal path from the conversion run: set(glog_MODULE_PATH "/tmp/convert-element-build-2232429621/share/glog/cmake"). Any installation to a different prefix will silently point cmake module resolution at a non-existent directory.

findings.summary: Android log library not linked on Android target
findings.evidence: CMake links glog PRIVATE against the Android log library when ANDROID is set (lines 463-466) and records it in glog_libraries_options_for_static_linking. Bazel glog and glog_internal carry no linkopts select() for @platforms//os:android; cross-compiling glog to Android with this BUILD will silently drop the -llog dependency.
